enemy-038-protomorph.designLock: Project-internal Protomorph label for the final adult Alien: Covenant creature lineage. The final film/VFX creature is described by MPC and the effects team as the Xenomorph; concept artist Colin Shulver reports that the production design work was called Protomorph. Do not present Protomorph as the official on-screen species name or promise a pixel-exact reconstruction. Preserve an approximately nine-foot/2.5-metre visual impression translated to gameplay scale: impossibly tall and very lean but still powerful, with a narrow waist, exposed rib cage, long sinewy arms, large clawed hands, long multi-jointed predatory legs and a hunched forward hunter posture. Exactly two arms and two legs. Eyeless elongated swept cranial dome, hard jaw, ivory teeth and a readable secondary inner jaw. Thin wet fascia over visible ribs, bone landmarks and sliding muscle; red-black, dark maroon, charcoal and bone palette with patchy wet highlights, not a solid blue-black metal shell. A long articulated organic tail must remain visibly connected at the sacrum in every frame and taper to one sharp tip. Exactly four principal dorsal tubes/processes remain attached to the upper back with stable count, shape and spacing across every clip. Strict orthographic right-facing gameplay profile; full dome, hands, feet, dorsal processes and entire tail inside every cell. Movement is contained, economical and observant at rest, then capable of a sudden great-cat/ape-like burst; head accents may use restrained bird/insect stabilization. Distinguish it from the pale ivory Neomorph with soft skin, sensory head and solid dorsal spines; from the tail-less, tube-less blue Deacon with a pointed mitre skull; and from the 1979 Big Chap's dominant blue-black biomechanical pipes, rigid suit-like mass and cleaner mechanical surface grammar. Retain Alien-family recognition without turning this Covenant form into Big Chap, a Queen, a Deacon or a Neomorph. No eyes, armor, clothing, technology, weapon, extra limbs, Queen crest, white skin, neon color, mechanical implant or magenta/pink anatomy. The V56 project sheet is a silhouette, palette and four-phase motion anchor only; it does not override the reviewed Covenant anatomy and must not be copied frame-for-frame.
